outcome: Packed red blood cell (pRBC) transfusion requirement
cohort: 40 patients diagnosed with placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) and placenta previa undergoing prophylactic aortic balloon occlusion (PABO) during a cesarean section
finding: The presence of T2 dark bands on MRI was significantly associated with adverse maternal outcomes, such as longer operative duration, higher estimated blood loss, increased blood transfusion requirement, and prolonged postoperative hospital stay, in patients undergoing prophylactic aortic balloon occlusion for placenta accreta spectrum or placenta previa during cesarean section.
